text: The added imageURL equality assertion has only actual and expected arguments. The title and clicked-dialog assertions do include expected-behavior messages. Under the direct human assertion-message rule, the image assertion needs a nonempty message describing the expected platform icon. This is an exact scoped source finding; the test was not run, and missing should alone is not the finding. The message omission remains in the fixed accepted task.
title: The Calendar notification image assertion lacks an expected-behavior message
